name: get-weather
title: Real-Time Terminal Weather Forecast
description: Fetches current conditions and meteorological reports for cities, countries, or macro-continental regions using wttr.in.

location.description: City, country, or continent name (e.g. 'London', 'Tokyo', 'Africa', 'Europe'). Defaults to local IP location.

format.description: Output format: 'compact' (one-line summary) or 'full' (ASCII forecast card)
